title: Peruvian Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Peruvian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken on skewers, grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chili pepper, lime juice, garlic, cilantro, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Place the chicken pieces in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them. Toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
